title: HF1897 (2023-2024 Regular): Permitted and trained school staff allowed to carry firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2023-02-16; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/HF/1897/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Version read: introduced bill (as filed), 2023-02-16. No votes recorded. Effective the day after enactment.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 299C.26): The superintendent of the Bureau of Criminal Apprehension, in consultation with security and law enforcement experts with appropriate qualifications and experience in responding to active shooter situations, must establish a school and postsecondary institution teacher and employee firearm training program that includes at a minimum training in active shooter situations.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 299C.26): The training must be provided at no cost to teachers and other employees of public elementary, middle, and secondary schools; charter schools under chapter 124E; and postsecondary institutions under chapter 136F or 137.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1d): (10) teachers and employees of public elementary, middle, and secondary schools; charter schools under chapter 124E; and postsecondary institutions under chapter 136F or 137 who have a school permit to carry under section 624.714, subdivision 8b.
Section 3 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 8b): A school permit to carry issued under this subdivision expires one year after the date of issue.
Section 4 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 18): This subdivision does not apply to teachers and employees authorized to carry firearms under section 609.66, subdivision 1d, paragraph (f).
